suppressedMessages.message: for..in loops iterate over the entire prototype chain, which is virtually never what you want. Use Object.{keys,values,entries}, and iterate over the resulting array.
The body of a for-in should be wrapped in an if statement to filter unwanted properties from the prototype.
Prefer default export on a file with single export.
